notes: Attribution exists to choose which parameters belong in a model of one specific security. What it was analysing was residual_ln — the level of ln(price) minus a valuation — across 471 names at ~10 sparse dates, defaulting to a cross-section that answers "why is Apple priced differently from Microsoft." Different quantity, different axis, different question. The target is now the security's own daily log return, ln(P_t / P_t-1), for one name, on the trading-day grid. Periodic data on a daily grid Most candidates aren't daily. CPI is monthly, revenue quarterly. They reach the daily axis by as-of
